environment_and_exact_command:
set -eu
unset CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING
/opt/host-cuda/compute-sanitizer/compute-sanitizer --version
nvcc -lineinfo -O0 -arch=sm_121 /out/kernel_sync_controls.cu -o /out/kernel-sync-controls
sha256sum /out/kernel_sync_controls.cu /out/kernel-sync-controls
python3 - <<'JOBS'
import json,pathlib,subprocess
results=[]
for tool,mode,expected in [('racecheck','race-clean',0),('racecheck','race',86),('synccheck','sync-clean',0),('synccheck','sync-invalid',86)]:
 argv=['/opt/host-cuda/compute-sanitizer/compute-sanitizer','--tool',tool,'--error-exitcode','86','--log-file','/out/'+mode+'.%p.log','/out/kernel-sync-controls',mode]
 with open('/out/'+mode+'.stdout-stderr.log','wb') as out:
  try:r=subprocess.run(argv,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=30);rc=r.returncode
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:rc=124
 results.append({'mode':mode,'argv':argv,'exit_code':rc,'expected_exit_code':expected})
pathlib.Path('/out/tool-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2));print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
JOBS
